description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Garen''' calls upon the might of ''Demacia'' onto the target enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]], dealing them [[File:Hybrid penetration icon.png|15px|link=True damage]] true damage as well as [[File:True Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight#True_sight|An icon representing the keyword True sight]] [[:Sight#True_sight|revealing]] them for 1 second at the start of the cast time.
description.text: Active: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia onto the target enemy champion, dealing them  true damage as well as revealing them for 1 second at the start of the cast time.

leveling.raw:
'''True Damage:'''
125 / 162.5 / 200 / 237.5 / 275 (+ 25 / 27.5 / 30 / 32.5 / 35% of target's '''missing''' health)

notes.raw: * The target will die if they're at least under 20 / 21.57 / 23.08 / 24.53 / 25.93% '''maximum''' health + 100 / 127.45 / 153.85 / 179.25 / 203.7 '''flat''' health on top of that. This does not count effects that mitigate [[File:Hybrid penetration icon.png|15px|link=True damage]] true damage, such as [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shields]]. * If '''Garen''' dies during ''Demacian Justice's'' cast time, it will visually appear as on cooldown and he won't be able to cast it until the cooldown has elapsed.(bug) ** This is fixed by clicking ''Demacian Justice's'' icon on the UI at the bottom of the screen. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
notes.text:
The target will die if they're at least under 20 / 21.57 / 23.08 / 24.53 / 25.93% maximum health + 100 / 127.45 / 153.85 / 179.25 / 203.7 flat health on top of that. This does not count effects that mitigate  true damage, such as shields.
If Garen dies during Demacian Justice's cast time, it will visually appear as on cooldown and he won't be able to cast it until the cooldown has elapsed.(bug)
* This is fixed by clicking Demacian Justice's icon on the UI at the bottom of the screen.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
